reason: $59 a month is a lot when library storytime on Tuesdays and the parks are free. I might try a drop-in once for a work-friendly afternoon, but I wouldn't commit to a membership.
objection: I already have free options for my toddler, so $59 a month for something I'd use a few times is hard to justify, and I can't tell yet if the Wi-Fi and seating would let me actually get work done.
would_change_my_mind: A free or cheap trial visit, plus proof the Wi-Fi and seating work for real work, and a monthly price nearer $30-35 or a punch-card option.
